_comment: Importable ruleset for the default branch (main). Apply with: gh api repos/three-cubes/kairix/rulesets --method POST --input .github/rulesets/main.json (requires Administration:Write). NOTE: the merge_queue rule is NOT included — GitHub's REST rulesets API rejects it (422) in both active and disabled mode; enable the merge queue via the web UI: Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets -> 'main' -> Add rule -> Require merge queue (grouping: ALLGREEN). Only the human admin role may bypass; agent Apps are not admins.
name: main
